beskerm_bedenkings.woord: oudste rotse op aarde / oudste rotse
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Two entries pull against each other: one keeps 'oudste rotse op aarde' (video) while another lists 'oudste rotse' under NIE. The block heading 'Van die oudste rotse op aarde' leaves out 'goed bewaarde'. 'Van die' makes it mean 'among the oldest', so I changed nothing, but a person may want to confirm that the heading is acceptable next to the narrowed wording in the text.
